shadows.name: pop
shadows.purpose: Light theme. Only surfaces floating over the canvas or page: overlay dock panel, timer chip, comment popovers and pins, cursor chat, undo toast.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The one accent-filled action per view.

components.name: Secondary Button

components.css: .ds-label { display: block; margin-bottom: 6px; font: 500 13px/1.375 Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; color: var(--foreground, #16181d); } .ds-input { width: 100%; height: 36px; padding: 0 10px; border-radius: 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #8a90a0); background: var(--surface, #fff); color: var(--foreground, #16181d); font: 400 14px Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: border-color 150ms; } .ds-input::placeholder { color: var(--ink-soft, #5b6170); } .ds-input:hover { border-color: color-mix(in srgb, var(--foreground, #16181d) 60%, transparent); } .ds-input:focus { outline: none; border-color: var(--accent-text, #2448d8); }

components.css: .ds-rail { display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 4px; width: 48px; padding: 12px 0; background: var(--surface, #fff); border-left: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e5ea); } .ds-rail-tab { position: relative; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 36px; height: 36px; border: 0; border-radius: 6px; background: transparent; color: var(--ink-soft, #5b6170); cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 150ms, color 150ms; } .ds-rail-tab:hover { background: var(--hover, #f0f1f4); color: var(--foreground, #16181d); } .ds-rail-tab.is-active { background: var(--selected, #e6e8ee); color: var(--foreground, #16181d); } .ds-rail-tab:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2d5bff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-rail-wire { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: -6px; width: 6px; height: 1px; background: var(--line-strong, #8a90a0); } .ds-port { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: -10px; width: 7px; height: 7px; transform: translateY(-50%); border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #8a90a0); background: var(--surface, #fff); box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-badge { position: absolute; top: -2px; right: -2px; min-width: 16px; height: 16px; padding: 0 4px; border-radius: 9999px; background: var(--foreground, #16181d); color: var(--background, #f6f7f9); font: 600 10px/16px Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; text-align: center; }

components.css: .ds-rows { list-style: none; margin: 0; padding: 0; border: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e5ea); border-radius: 8px; background: var(--surface, #fff); } .ds-row { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 12px; min-height: 56px; padding: 8px 12px; border-bottom: 1px solid var(--line, #e3e5ea); font-family: Geist, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 150ms; } .ds-row:last-child { border-bottom: 0; } .ds-row:hover { background: var(--hover, #f0f1f4); } .ds-row-icon { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; width: 32px; height: 32px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #8a90a0); border-radius: 4px; color: var(--ink-soft, #5b6170); } .ds-row-title { flex: 1; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500; color: var(--foreground, #16181d); text-decoration: none; } .ds-row-title:hover { text-decoration: underline; text-underline-offset: 2px; } .ds-row-title:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--accent, #2d5bff); outline-offset: 2px; } .ds-tag { padding: 2px 6px; border: 1px solid var(--line-strong, #8a90a0); border-radius: 4px; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-soft, #5b6170); } .ds-row-date { width: 112px; text-align: right; font-size: 12px; color: var(--ink-soft, #5b6170); font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; }

narrative.overview:
The chrome speaks the same box-and-connector language the AI draws on the canvas. Controls are boxes drawn with 1px hairlines; where one thing opens or feeds another, a thin connector meets it at a small square port. The result reads as a professional tool of its category (Figma, Linear, tldraw's own panels) rather than a playful whiteboard clone: graphite neutrals, one ink-blue action color, one sans family, straight small radii.

The canvas is the product, so the chrome is dense and quiet. All app controls live in a single 48px rail on the right edge of the board, outside tldraw's canvas, and every rail tab opens into the same 320px docked panel; on wide screens the canvas shrinks to make room instead of being covered. The system refuses the floating-pill-toolbar-over-canvas arrangement every whiteboard clone ships. Depth is flat at rest; a soft shadow appears only on surfaces that genuinely float over the canvas.

Both themes are first-class. Every text pair clears 4.5:1 and every field boundary and focus line clears 3:1 in light and dark (WCAG 1.4.3 / 1.4.11), which is why interactive boundaries use the strong line and never the structural one. The owner has rejected the editorial "AI house style" (serif mastheads, ivory paper, mono small-caps labels, staggered reveals) and any hand-drawn or paper look.
keyCharacteristics: Graphite neutrals plus a single ink-blue action color.
1px hairlines everywhere; square 7px ports where a connector attaches.
Geist sans throughout with stylistic set `ss01`; tabular figures for live numbers.
One right rail, one docked panel; nothing app-owned floats over tldraw's chrome.
Flat at rest; one shared soft shadow for floating surfaces only.

rules.name: The One Ink Rule
rules.body: The accent is reserved for the primary action, on-state, selection and focus. Everything else is neutral; a second accent-filled control on the same view means one of them is wrong.

rules.name: The Two Lines Rule
rules.body: `line` divides structure; `line-strong` bounds anything you can type into or press. Never draw a field, secondary button or tag with the structural line: it fails 3:1.

rules.name: The Tabular Rule
rules.body: Every number that changes or lines up (timer, badge counts, avatar overflow, edit dates) uses tabular figures in a fixed-width cell so it never jitters.

rules.name: The One Family Rule
rules.body: Geist sans only. No serif display, no mono labels, no uppercase-tracked eyebrows above headings.

rules.name: The Float-Only Shadow Rule
rules.body: If a surface is docked, inline or part of the page flow, it has a hairline and no shadow. Shadow means "this sits on top of the canvas".

rules.name: The Port Rule
rules.body: A port marks a real connection. Use it only where a connector meets a node or a control meets what it opens; never as a bullet, divider ornament or decoration.

dos: Do keep the accent to one primary action per view, plus on-states, selection and focus.
Do bound every field, secondary button and tag with `line-strong` (≥3:1); use `line` only for structural dividers.
Do put new board tools in the right rail and open them in the dock panel at 320px.
Do use a port and a 1px connector where a control attaches to what it opens, and nowhere else.
Do use `shadow-pop` only on surfaces that float over the canvas or page; dock beside, don't float over.
Do set every live or aligned number in tabular figures.
Do give coarse pointers 44px targets with `pointer-coarse` overrides instead of loosening desktop density.
Do confirm or offer undo for anything that changes the board for everyone, inline next to the item.
donts: Don't float pill toolbars or app controls over the tldraw canvas or its own menus.
Don't introduce a second accent hue, gradients, or an accent-filled secondary action.
Don't add a serif or mono display face, uppercase tracked eyebrows, ivory paper textures, hand-drawn strokes, or staggered reveal choreography.
Don't use radii above 8px on chrome, or pill shapes outside avatars, badges and the switch.
Don't add shadows to docked or in-flow surfaces, or use heavier shadows than Pop.
Don't use translucent white panels with backdrop blur; surfaces are opaque theme tokens.
